name: llama.cpp CUDA on nvidia-quadro-rtx-8000: Llama-2-7B Q4_0 FA-on tg128 decode tok/s (scoreboard #15013)
methodology: COMMUNITY-SCOREBOARD (llama.cpp discussion #15013, maintainer-curated). llama-bench -m llama-2-7b.Q4_0.gguf -ngl 99 -fa 1. llama-bench default -r 5 repeats, mean reported (the +/- std is in the source row, not stored). Single GPU, per-request batch 1, NOT an aggregate across concurrent requests. Prompt length is the bench default for the tg test (the scored quantity is the 128 generated tokens). Re-read of the discussion page on 2026-10-16.
notes: Quadro RTX 8000, 48 GB / GDDR6 / 384 bit, build 79c1160, reporter @Hedede. Same TU102 as the Quadro RTX 6000 with doubled memory, which is why tg128 lands within 2% of it. Maintainer-verified row. tg128 is the bandwidth-bound cell of the pair.
